proposition.claim:
Recorded check: General Maxwell tangential traces cannot be absorbed by the asserted scalar potentials

Positive case: Omega=(-2,2)^3,Ddelta=(-1,1)^3,D=(-1/4,1/4)^3,delta3/4,diam2sqrt3<6delta, convex Lipschitz interior patches. nu=kappa=1 real positive, form coercivityC1=1. Local harmonic testsH0(curl), no physical boundary trace imposed on the interior patch. Impedance case: Omega=(-2,2)^2x(0,2),D**=(-1,1)^2x(0,1),only physical facez0,n=-ez; surrounding truncated nested cubes give positive artificial-face gaps. mu=epsilon=lambda=1,omega>1, smooth fields have finite Hcurl and L2 tangential trace; exact PDE and physical impedance imply the specified local weak harmonicity.

Recorded check: Elastic cutoff and spectral quadratic forms omit the strain normalization factor

C identity on symmetric matrices, interiorD*=(-1,1)^2,eta=(1-x^2)^2(1-y^2)^2 C1 zero on boundary. Staticu=e1 andu=(x,0) are locally harmonic; latter not a zero-strain kernel element. Waveu=(0,exp(i sqrt2 x)),omega=rho1 solves-div epsilon(u)-u0 on interior patch.
